title: Naming the Doer with Por
goal: Decide when to name the doer with por in a passive with ser, and keep por for people and groups, not tools.
grammar: the doer with por in the passive with ser

items: I can name the doer of a passive with *por* when it is important.
I can leave the doer out when it is obvious or unknown.
I can tell *por* (the doer) from *con* (a tool) and from *por* (a reason).
